issues: wms/server.py routes do not call the domain layer directly: each request is rebuilt as a CLI argv list and sent through app.execute and argparse, so the HTTP layer depends on CLI option syntax (for example the '--opt=value' tricks and the bans on ':' in SKUs and ',' in serials).

wms/server.py _run_request decides between 404 and 400 by checking whether the UserError message starts with 'unknown ', which is fragile: 'unknown role' and 'unknown status' come back as 404, and any reworded message silently changes the status code.

wms/engine.py void_movement, on an average-costed receipt, subtracts q and v but keeps the old last_avg, so when Q drops to 0 a later increasing adjust is still costed with an average that includes the voided receipt.

tests/test_core.py has only three tests for the whole stock, movement, costing and void section (section 4/5 edge cases such as fifo void after consumption, lot expiry conflicts, and adjusts below reserved are untested) and contains a dead `... if False else None` assertion line.

wms/products.py import_products puts several row errors into one UserError by joining them with '\nerror: ', which ties domain code to the CLI's stderr format and gives the HTTP API odd messages; product commands are also split oddly between catalog.py and products.py with a deferred import to avoid a cycle.

The global RLock in app.py/server.py serialises every request, so the 'parallel' server is effectively single-threaded, and only UserError is caught in app.main, so any unexpected sqlite or Decimal exception escapes as a traceback instead of a clean error.
strengths: All stock changes go through one place (engine.post, cost_in/cost_out/restore_out), with fifo consumption slices recorded explicitly, which makes voids, transfers and cancellations reverse costing exactly.

Money and quantities are stored as Decimal strings and parsed with strict regex/precision checks, every SQL statement is parameterised, and each command runs inside a single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction that rolls back on any error.

A small command registry declares each command's role and argument setup, so permission checks happen in one place; most tests drive the real CLI and HTTP server end to end, including idempotency replay and concurrent confirms.
